fields.description: Detects possible DLL hijacking of winmde.dll by looking for suspicious image loads, loading this DLL from unexpected locations.
fields.name: Possible DLL Hijacking of winmde.dll
fields.query: event.type="ModuleLoad" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\winmde.dll" and (not module.path="c:\windows\system32\*")))
